title: REPORT on the Council position on the draft general budget of the European Union for the financial year 2026
part_text: 9. Welcomes the Commission's new efforts to present more options for new sources of revenue for the Union budget; in this respect, takes note of the Commission’s proposal for a Council Decision on the System of Own Resources of the European Union of 16 July 2025; stresses that, in the context of the search for new own resources, consideration should be given to the introduction of a Digital Service Tax (DST), as already proposed by the Commission in 2018; stresses that new genuine own resources are essential not only to enable repayment of NGEU borrowing, but to ensure that the Union is equipped to cover its higher spending needs; calls on the Council to speed up its work on the new own resources;
